description: Updates the payment_status of a payment.

body.paymentStatus: enum, required - SUCCESS | PENDING | FAILED | PARTIAL

validation: paymentStatus must be one of SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED, PARTIAL (CHECK)

errors.condition: paymentStatus missing or not a recognized enum value

constraints: payment_status NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS' CHECK IN (SUCCESS, PENDING, FAILED, PARTIAL)

notes: database/api_contracts_test/015_payment.sql's API-T127 scenario targets rows by transaction_reference = 'TXN0001' rather than paymentId and updated 2 rows in testing (marked DB GAP in docs/API_Contracts_and_Test_Results.xlsx). As with API-059, this is a downstream symptom of the missing UNIQUE constraint on transaction_reference (API-064's gap), not a defect in this endpoint's own contract - this endpoint's path parameter is already the unique primary key (paymentId), which is unaffected by the transaction_reference gap.
